task: PERF-06-A detached TextButtons retained by PresentationAudioClient
contract: Goal: UI buttons removed from PlayerGui without Destroy are no longer retained by the audio binding table. Root cause: buttonConnections is weak-keyed but its values hold connections whose closures capture the button, so entries pin their keys; cleanup ran only on Destroying. Owner: PresentationAudioClient (UI sound binding). No new owners, config, remotes or saved data. Preserved: hover/click/focus cue behaviour, suppression attributes, one-shot pooling. Done when: SceneAnalysisService attributes no accumulating TextButtons to PresentationAudioClient after the same normal UI flow, and UI click/hover sounds still bind for re-added buttons.
verification: Play: normal start-screen Play, car panel/popups, dealership browser, garage; SceneAnalysis unparented query before/after; console scan.
